name: x.ai / SpaceXSI
design_analysis_text: 目前官方以 SpaceXSI 作為網站標題、標誌替代文字與社群名稱；法律版權仍為 ©2026 SpaceXAI LLC。現行深色首頁採黑底、XVF 變體無襯線字體、白色及深灰膠囊 CTA。首屏 Grok4.7 公告、旋轉動詞標題，下接 Chat/Build/Bot/Imagine/Voice 五張產品卡、API 與程式碼、三組數字、四則新聞、兩張入門卡及完整十組頁尾。窄版產品與新聞排單欄、頁尾兩欄。相較舊稿，品牌、頁尾連結與深色狀態必須更新；本次已真正呼叫 Google Stitch MCP 保存新桌面和實際 MOBILE 原始輸出，再以完整官方 DOM、樣式及76個公開原始素材校正。
visual_review_text: Owner inspected all five final comparison montage rasters:6 desktop and9 narrow original viewport segments per side, exact native1280×720 and390×844 dimensions. Full continuous coverage reaches3763 desktop and6853 narrow pixels in both sides. Current branding, hero, all five product cards, API/code, settled numbers, four news cards, both getting-started cards and all footer groups were compared. Actual official/local narrow root-menu rasters were inspected and open/close button operation passed. Local build fingerprint and capture-time preview SHA bind all final captures to current bytes. Native provider thumbnails were inspected: they approximate the theme but alter card/layout/assets and remain unaccepted.
implementation_method: Source-backed correction after genuine native Google Stitch edit. Complete current per-width public DOM/CSS and76 original assets, plus an unchanged previously acquired official AgentOrb renderer adaptation with recorded source hashes; original application/network scripts removed.
corrections: Updated old SpaceXAI logo accessibility/social/news branding to observed SpaceXSI while retaining source ©2026 SpaceXAI LLC legal copyright. Preserved grok.com, Startup Terms, AUP and Privacy choices footer content.
Replaced prior incomplete footer/custom section geometry using full current per-width source templates, recovering exact3763/6853px full-page heights.

Repaired serialized number-flow fallback300/150/90 to its observed settled aria values400/200/122; restored the voice orb using unchanged original GLSL renderer adaptation in current dark card canvas.
Recreated narrow root menu from actual observed public markup and tested open/close buttons. Header narrow CTA visibility follows a scoped scroll threshold matching reviewed captures.
remaining_differences_and_limits: Hero rotating word and underline are frozen to the observed ship frame. Chat/build/bot transcript motion and product-card transitions are frozen; exact title/transcript animation timing is unverified.

Official counters are captured mid-transition on desktop while local shows settled400M+/200K/122. Narrow settled numbers match. Exact digit roll timing and temporary source news-image blur/loading states are not recreated.

Voice orb uses preserved official renderer math, but seed/time/background initialization and particle positions are not synchronized with the current live frame. The developer code background preserves native CSS fallback gradients but omits live Paper shader noise/motion, leaving a darker smoother texture.

Narrow root menu opening and close-button operation were tested. Nested/desktop menus, light-theme switching, language tabs/copy, privacy choices, sign-in, API, sales and other services remain unverified; menu scrollbar location and hero CTA scroll trigger are approximations.
Native provider output remains unaccepted. Other widths/locales, physical-phone behavior, authenticated services and hosted-publication parity are not claimed.
progress_note: Current-hash complete desktop/narrow raster inspection:3763/6853px, current SpaceXSI/footer/metrics/orb/menu corrected. Original native exports retained; motion/shader/interaction/service limits explicit; accepted=false.
